Struct.name: SeamBindVertex32
Struct.Math: 12 + 12 + 4 + 4 = 32 bytes. 32 mod 16 = 0. GPU fetch stride is one half cache line and ARM64-safe.

Struct.name: SeamBindingProfileDTO
Struct.Math: 32 bytes scalar block + 12 color + 4 pad + 16 ulong pad = 64 bytes.

Struct.name: SeamBindCounters64
Struct.Math: 10 scalar fields through offset 36, then 24 padding bytes at offsets 40, 48, 56. Total 64 bytes.

Struct.name: SeamMeshRollbackFenceDTO
Struct.Math: 8 uint fields * 4 = 32 bytes. Magic writes VTSF, Version writes 1, EndianMarker writes 0x01020304 through manual little-endian byte order.

SELF_AUDIT.SCALABILITY_CURVE_EXPLANATION: GlobalQualityWeight is consumed as a continuous scalar. ResolveLodProfile uses math.lerp over quality and LodContinuityBias to expand lower-LOD snap radius, normal blend distance, texture falloff, and hash cell size without binary low/high branches. EvaluateSeamSnappingJob and BakeSeamTransitionColorsJob lerp between a cheap linear distance ramp and a smoother polynomial ramp, so weights below 0.3 bias toward cheaper linear math and wider coarse-LOD tolerances, mid weights preserve stable blend, and high/ultra weights tighten positional error while spending saved runtime budget on shader interpretation of pre-baked vertex normals/alpha. Gameplay truth, DTO layout, rollback route, and save identity do not change with quality.

SELF_AUDIT.DEAR_LIE_CONFIRMATION: The physical truth is only vertex position sealing in baked geometry. The visual lie is averaged seam normals plus pre-baked vertex alpha falloff, allowing UberNoir/material code to render a smooth cave-to-terrain transition without runtime decals, skirt geometry, or physics smoothing. Rejected heavy route: runtime mesh deformation or O(N*M) nearest-neighbor scans plus cover-up geometry. Actual route: O(E) edge marking + O(Vboundary) hash build + O(Vterrain * 27 * localBucket) bounded hash probes. Runtime complexity after bake is O(0) for seam solving.
